what: UK buyer ordered a Christmas present from Etsy seller on November 25, 2025; had not received it as of March 18, 2026 despite messaging the seller; seller's website is now unavailable.
verbatim_snippet: "I ordered a Christmas preasant from Twice As Nice Digitals on 25/11/2025 via Etsy. I have still not recieved it as of 18/03/2026 despite messaging Michael, the owner. His web site is now unavailable. Looks like yet another scam. Dont use either company if you want to keep your money."
notes: Trustpilot etsy.co.uk profile; not confirmed fetched directly (UK profile separate from www.etsy.com profile which was fetched). Wait time: approximately 4 months. Purchase occasion: Christmas gift. Seller shop status: unavailable/closed.
